title: Volume of a Paraboloid Cap in Cylindrical Coordinates
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the volume of the solid under z = 4 - r^2 above the xy-plane using cylindrical coordinates.

steps.title: Determine Cylindrical Integration Bounds
steps.mathExpression: z = 0 \implies 4 - r^2 = 0 \implies r = 2; \quad 0 \le z \le 4 - r^2, \; 0 \le r \le 2, \; 0 \le \theta \le 2\pi
steps.explanation: The base is circle of radius 2; height extends from 0 to 4 - r^2.
steps.why: Setting up limits in cylindrical coordinates.

steps.title: Set Up and Integrate
steps.mathExpression: V = \int_0^{2\pi} d\theta \int_0^2 r (4 - r^2) \, dr = 2\pi \int_0^2 (4r - r^3) \, dr = 2\pi \left[ 2r^2 - \frac{r^4}{4} \right]_0^2 = 2\pi (8 - 4) = 8\pi
steps.explanation: Evaluate the radial integral with Jacobian factor r.
